page.title: Mallorcan Restaurant in Palma Old Town · Aljub
page.meta: Aljub is a Mallorcan restaurant in Palma's old town, open for dinner Tuesday to Saturday. See every dish, price and allergen before you book.

items.name: Mallorcan cracked olives
items.description: Green olives from Mallorca, cured with fennel and chilli.

items.name: Coca de trempó
items.description: Thin flatbread with chopped tomato, green pepper and onion.

items.name: Sobrassada on toast
items.description: Black pig sobrassada with Maó cheese and honey.

items.name: Trempó salad
items.description: Tomato, green pepper and onion, dressed with Mallorcan olive oil.

items.name: Red prawns from Sóller
items.description: Four prawns, grilled with sea salt and olive oil.

items.name: Frit mallorquí
items.description: Lamb and lamb offal, fried with potato, red pepper and fennel.

items.name: Tumbet
items.description: Fried potato, aubergine and red pepper, baked under tomato sauce.

items.name: Arròs brut
items.description: Soupy spiced rice with rabbit, pork and seasonal vegetables.

items.name: Black pig loin with cabbage
items.description: Mallorcan black pig wrapped in cabbage, with sobrassada and pine nuts.

items.name: Gató with almond ice cream
items.description: Mallorcan almond cake, made without flour.

items.name: Ensaïmada with cream
items.description: Pork lard pastry, filled with custard and served warm.

items.name: Tasting menu
items.description: Seven courses, served to the whole table, priced per person. Island wines with each course add €60 per person.
